title: Standardized environmental enrichment for rodents in Marlau cage
protocol: Place the ground floor box on a flat surface using both handles with the side containing water bottles facing you.
Insert the plastic wall into the stripes to separate the ground floor into two sections, G1 on the left and G2 on the right.
Place the 3 running wheels on the rear side of the G2 section.
Stabilize the red rectangular house on the G2 ground using magnetic sites.
Fill the G2 ground with autoclaved bedding material to a height of 2-3 cm.
Add the climbing ladder on the right side of the running wheels in G2.
Insert the pellet feeder into the rectangular hole on the front side of G1.
Place the slide tunnel into the G1 section on the left side of the pellet feeder.
Attach water bottles to the G2 front side.
Add food pellets in the feeder and also spread them throughout the bedding material in the G1 section.
Add paper wool in G1 and aspen wood wool in G2.
Pile up the upper floor box on the ground floor box.
Place the maze on the ground of the upper floor.
Be careful to correctly position the maze since it has two sides.
Fill the maze with autoclaved bedding material to a height of 1 cm.
Put all rats in the G2 section near the climbing ladder.
Identify the next maze configuration.
Uncover the lid, remove the former maze and add the new one.
Fill the maze with autoclaved bedding material to a height of 1 cm.
Cover the cage with its lid.
Uncover the lid, and move all animals to a conventional cage.
Remove the upper floor, and place all remaining animals in the conventional cage.
Remove all items from the ground floor and all the bedding material.
Wash and dry all items.
